summary.text: Mitch Gore is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 89 who has represented the district since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a law enforcement officer with the Marion County Sheriff's Office.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Drew Weingarten, the Libertarian nominee.

paragraphs.text: Gore was born in Indianapolis and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Indianapolis.
His career experience includes working as a captain with the Marion County Sheriff's Office and as a business operator.
He took office in the Indiana House on November 4, 2020, succeeding Cindy Kirchhofer.
